(rule!
 (let* ((markers
         (for*/list ((r (in-range 1 (- (rows g) 1)))
                     (c (in-range 1 (- (cols g) 1)))
                     #:when (not (= (at g r c) 0)))
           (list r c)))
        (selected (take markers (min 2 (length markers)))))
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)))
             ((p selected))
     (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
       (paint-cells
        out
        (filter (lambda (q) (not (and (= (first q) r) (= (second q) c))))
                (positions-in-rect (- r 1) (- c 1) (+ r 1) (+ c 1)))
        (at g r c))))))
